lesson.title: Adding a 2-Digit Number and a 1-Digit Number
lesson.description: Children learn to add a 2-digit number to a 1-digit number without regrouping, both horizontally and vertically.
lesson.content:
A {{term:2-digit number}} has tens and ones, like {{example:23}} which is 2 tens and 3 ones. A {{term:1-digit number}} like {{example:4}} has only ones. When we add them, we join the ones together and keep the tens the same. So {{example:23 + 4 = 27}}.

We can also add {{term:vertically}}, writing one number above the other with ones lined under ones. For {{example:45 + 3}}, we add 5 ones + 3 ones = 8 ones and keep the 4 tens, so {{example:45 + 3 = 48}}.

Now try it yourself: work out {{example:32 + 6}} by first adding the ones, then keeping the tens the same.
